subject: Merchant onboarding: entity verification and preferred PO routing
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@arcwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor@arcwave.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: ArcWave — onboarding packet and quick questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking the time earlier this week. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for transaction routing and POs, and wanted to start the vendor master process so our finance team can receive POs. Attaching the completed legal entity worksheet and a copy of our W-9 (attached).

Quick questions before we send the banking PDF:
- For the “registered legal name” field — do you need DBA in a separate field or will the legal name + aliases in one line suffice?
- Is Redwood able to accept ACH and wire (our bank supports both)?
- Who should be listed as the AP contact on the PO? We typically route to ap@arcwave.com but can use a Redwood-designated contact if needed.

Please confirm the next steps and any specific format requirements for tax/bank docs.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance, ArcWave Labs
elena@arcwave.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: ArcWave_LegalWorksheet.pdf (pdf), ArcWave_W9.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@arcwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2029 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArcWave — onboarding packet and quick questions

Elena —

Thanks, and looks good as a first pass. Quick answers below and next steps.

- Registered legal name: please provide the full legal entity exactly as it appears on the W-9 in the "legal_name" field. Put any DBAs in the "alternate_names" field — we keep these separate for matching to contracts and tax records.
- Payment methods: we accept ACH and wire. For ACH we need account + routing; for wire, SWIFT/ABA and intermediary details if applicable. A PDF from the bank (voided check or bank letter) is preferred but not required for initial setup.
- AP contact: listing ap@arcwave.com is fine. We also ask for a secondary contact (name + phone) for payment questions.

Next steps (for completeness):
1) Finalize the legal name field on the worksheet and add DBA to "alternate_names" if any.
2) Share a bank stub (PDF) for routing verification.
3) Confirm remit address and preferred PO email.
4) Once we receive docs I'll route internally to Karthik for tax and ERP mapping. He'll confirm the vendor code and preferred PO routing.

Looping in Karthik to start the ERP mapping and to confirm any validation rules on our side.

Marissa
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-4412

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.docx (docx)

Best,

Hi Victor / Elena —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the bank stub. I've started the vendor code creation in our ERP; provisional vendor_id is VW-48291. A couple of operational notes before I move to active status:

- Legal name must match W-9 exactly (ArcWave Laboratories, Inc.). I'll attach a one-page enrollment summary listing how the name and aliases will be stored.
- For ACH: Redwood requires ACH with 9-digit routing + account (we will store masked account numbers). For initial PO acceptance you can provide masked numbers; full details are required before first settlement.
- Sandbox PO test: yes — we can send a test PO to ap+sandbox@arcwave.com. We'll send a CIM-format PO (CSV with headers) this Monday with an example invoice number so you can validate NetLedger mapping.

Grace, can you help confirm if there are any tax withholding flags on this EIN? If not, we'll flip the vendor to active once we receive the full bank details and confirm AP mailbox.

Thanks — I expect turnaround of 2 business days once we receive the final bank doc.

Karthik Iyer
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0990
